final: WITH counts AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), status_totals AS (SELECT orderflow, SUM(cnt) as total_for_status FROM counts GROUP BY orderflow), with_shares AS (SELECT c.ordervault, c.orderflow, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / CAST(st.total_for_status AS REAL) as share FROM counts c JOIN status_totals st ON c.orderflow = st.orderflow), status_averages AS (SELECT orderflow, AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares GROUP BY orderflow), above_average AS (SELECT ws.ordervault, ws.orderflow, ws.cnt, ws.share, ws.share - sa.avg_share as diff FROM with_shares ws JOIN status_averages sa ON ws.orderflow = sa.orderflow WHERE ws.share > sa.avg_share) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, share, diff FROM above_average ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
